title: Plastics Engineering Technology, B.S. (Behrend)
notes: Penn State Erie, The Behrend College -- a Behrend-only specialty tied to Erie's plastics industry with no University Park equivalent at all (confirmed via `ls Backend/degree_plans` -- no PLET/PES-prefixed plan or department catalog existed in this repo before this session). Pattern B by definition. Built fresh as PLETBH (no existing UP code to suffix). Real 8-semester Suggested Academic Plan, 134 total credits, taken verbatim from the live 2026-27 Behrend bulletin page (re-confirmed semester-by-semester via a second, more targeted fetch, since the plan's own real course sequencing is unusual -- see below). New pes_catalog.json (14 courses) and plet_catalog.json (29 courses) were created this session, scraped from bulletins.psu.edu/university-course-descriptions/undergraduate/{pes,plet}/, since neither department existed in this repo's catalogs at all. 'Technical Elective (300/400-level)' (x3: Fourth Year Fall x2, Fourth Year Spring x1) and 'Advanced Technical Elective' (x1, Fourth Year Fall) are wired to the bulletin's own two-tier Departmentally Approved Electives lists (Advanced: PLET 466/481/483/484/497, PES 340/460, CHEM 202/203/210/212; Technical: all Advanced courses plus PLET 468, PES 320, MET 425, QC 450, BME 443, IE 302). REAL BULLETIN QUIRK, not a data-entry error on this plan's part: PLET 227 is listed in Third Year Spring, but its own real catalog prereq (PLET 330's and PLET 366's, both Third Year Fall) both require PLET 227 to already be complete -- verified this is genuinely how the live bulletin table is laid out (re-fetched and cross-checked), not a misread. Rather than silently reorder the bulletin's own published semester labels, this plan keeps PLET 227 in its real, published Third Year Spring slot: build_full_plan's simulation schedules every item by actual prereq eligibility regardless of which nominal semester bucket houses it (see ME-2026's own notes for the same principle), so PLET 227 ends up ACTUALLY scheduled before PLET 330/366 in the real simulated term sequence even though it's nominally listed a semester later -- confirmed via a clean, zero-scheduling-failure build_full_plan run. Real-prereq-chain fixes (same 'close the real gap' convention as every other major in this repo): (1) CHEM 110 (First Year Spring) needs MATH 22, which needs MATH 21 -- neither is in this program's own MATH 41 -> 83 -> 210 -> 211 technical-math ladder; added MATH 21 + MATH 22 (Semester 1). (2) MET 111 and MET 213 both have a real prereq of literally MATH 26 OR MATH 81, also outside this ladder; added MATH 81 (Semester 1). Raised max_credits_per_semester from 18 to 20 (the real 134cr load plus the MATH 21/22/81 gap-closing additions otherwise overflow an 8-term/4-year plan by 1-2 terms purely on credit-cap pressure, not real prereq depth -- same fix, same justification, as ME-2026's own precedent). Verified via build_full_plan (with today pinned to July 1 of the start year, matching TestHistoricalCatalogYears' own convention): zero warnings, graduates cleanly in the standard 8 terms/4 years.
